name: Ore wa Shoujo Mangaka
source:
Lighthearted comedy and romance await in this PSP visual novel about a young man chasing his dream - to become a top shoujo manga artist. Kamio Kenji made his pro debut at the extraordinary age of 13, but now finds himself in a slump. Desperate for a way to regain his popularity, he decides to reinvent himself... as a cute girl! Join Kenji on a hilarious crossdressing adventure, seeking fame and fortune in the world of shoujo manga while building relationships with five lovable girls. There's your classmate and pro manga artist Rinna, your sharp-tongued assistant Hisui, editor and older sister Chika, idol voice actress Haruka, and the bookish Kaede who doesn't like manga at all. While romancing your favorite heroine, you'll also be able to engage in fun activities like learning manga industry jargon and designing your own manga covers. You can even import your own images into the game for a personalized manga experience! Live the wild life of a manga artist today, with this great game from Giza10.

[From [url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PSP4012]JBOX[/url]]
translation:
这款PSP视觉小说讲述了一名青年追逐梦想、立志成为顶尖少女漫画家的故事，等待玩家的是轻松愉快的喜剧与恋爱。神尾贤二年仅13岁便以惊人的年龄职业出道，如今却陷入低谷。为了重拾人气，他走投无路之下决定彻底改变形象…变成一名可爱的女孩！加入贤二爆笑的男扮女装冒险，在少女漫画界追求名声与财富，同时与五名可爱的女孩建立关系：同班同学兼职业漫画家凛奈、言辞犀利的助手翡翠、编辑兼姐姐千佳、偶像声优遥，以及完全不喜欢漫画、嗜书如命的枫。攻略心仪女主角之余，你还可以参加各种有趣活动，例如学习漫画业界术语、设计自己的漫画封面。甚至还能把自己的图片导入游戏，打造个性化的漫画体验！立即在Giza10带来的这款佳作中，体验漫画家的疯狂人生吧。

[摘自[url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PSP4012]JBOX[/url]]
